title: Learning Tools Tap
hook: Choose the tool that fits the thinking job.
roundStructure: Round 1 lexical-semantic A-Z; Round 2 retrieval-action A-Z; 4+4+4+4+4+4+2 chunks
responseSpace: one to two predictable beats of retrieval space before target confirmation
visualStyle: clean 3D classroom storybook, colorful supplies, simple desks, isolated objects; visual identity: Learning Tools Tap

creativeFingerprint.round2Grammar: operation cue -> recall gap -> target -> low-risk gesture
creativeFingerprint.authorialIntent: Make Learning Tools Tap about cognitive function: look up, record, retrieve, calculate, draw, revise, and communicate are different learning operations, and non-tools such as Uniform are labeled honestly.
creativeFingerprint.lyricIdentity: Each object answers the question 'what kind of thinking can this support?' rather than being praised just for appearing in school.
